label: Строка STYLE в промте
value: noir watercolour and ink illustration with a grunge printmaking finish. DRAWING: accurate but economical draughtsmanship — correct anatomy, proportion and perspective, believable weight and material behaviour, simple confident contour rather than heavy rendering. WASH: broad continuous washes laid in long unbroken strokes, each material held to two or three value steps only; transitions blended wet-in-wet inside the shape so the tone flows smoothly; hard wash edges appear only where a real material edge exists; the surface stays smooth and even, with no granulation and no accumulation of small marks. Cloth is described by long continuous fold edges and large simple planes of tone. DETAIL: moderate and selective — readable detail on the focal object only, everything else summarised in broad washes and a few contour lines; no over-rendering. TEXTURE: a faint even tooth of the painting surface, subtle and uniform across the whole picture, never resolving into dots, patches or a repeating pattern. PALETTE: washed gray-blue, cold oceanic gray, off-white, dirty cream, dirty beige, muted amber-gray, faded yellow, diluted ink black, kept pale overall. CONTRAST: restrained — a few dark ink accents and mid-tone shadows against large areas of pale wash, not heavy black masses. DEPTH: separated by wash value and line weight, never by photographic depth of field.

label: Финальная фиксация стиля
value: unified single-frame noir watercolour and ink illustration, grunge printmaking finish, broad continuous transparent washes with smooth wet-in-wet transitions, few value steps per material, long clean fold edges, economical accurate drawing, selective detail on the focal object, restrained mid-tone contrast, smooth even surface with no speckling, full-bleed composition reaching all four edges with completely clean edges.
